notes.en: Static content review only. SKILL.md, bundled scripts and license notices reviewed against the manifest: declared capabilities execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write and required tool exec.shell match shipped content; the Microsoft MarkItDown package is explicitly NOT bundled; guest extractors use only the declared pins openpyxl==3.1.5 and pdfminer.six==20221105 plus stdlib; native routes are optional task capabilities discovered via tools.search and add no authority; encrypted PDFs and scans fail closed with native-routing receipts. No self-granted trust, no unlisted-skill fetch, no install-time privilege. Guest execution remains UNPROVEN (Main-owned); this is not runtime qualification or App acceptance.
notes.zh-Hans: 仅静态内容审核。已按清单核对 SKILL.md、随附脚本与许可声明：声明能力 execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write 与必需工具 exec.shell 和实际内容一致；Microsoft MarkItDown 包明确未随附；来宾提取器仅使用声明 pin（openpyxl==3.1.5、pdfminer.six==20221105）与 stdlib；原生路线为可选任务能力，经 tools.search 发现且不增加权限；加密 PDF 与扫描件闭式失败并给出原生路由回执。无自我授权信任、无拉取未列名 Skill、无安装时特权。来宾执行仍为未证实（Main 负责）；此非运行时鉴定或 App 验收。

reviewedPythonPackages.purpose: XLSX workbook -> Markdown table extraction (read-only, bounded, cached formula values only); identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-openpyxl (3.1.5+dfsg)
